name: Canvas Layout
frequency: every extraction (create grid on first, slot on subsequent)

domain_columns.instruction: Define per project on first extraction. Base on source app navigation order. Record in companion ref.

placement_procedure: Check existing artboard positions via get_basic_info
Find the target domain column (or create it)
Find the correct tier row within the column
Create artboard, then position with update_styles({ top, left })
Add domain label text node above column if first artboard in column

group_labels.frequency: once per column, not per artboard
